name: St. Ruadhán of Lorrha
bio: Ruadán mac Fergusa Birn, known also as Rowan, Ruadon, Roadan, Rodan, and Ruadhán, was an Irish Christian abbot who founded the monastery of Lorrha near Terryglass. He was renowned for his gift of prophecy and counted among the "Twelve Apostles of Ireland," that band of holy disciples who studied under St. Finian at Clonard and carried the monastic ideal across the island. After his death he was venerated as a saint, and his feast day is observed on 15 April.

prayer.text: O God, who endowed your servant Ruadhán with the gift of prophecy and called him to found a monastery at Lorrha, grant through his intercession that we may discern your will and walk faithfully in your ways. We ask this through Christ our Lord. Amen.
